name: compress.zstd
doc:
Zstandard (RFC 8878); the decoder (runtime/src/std_zstd.c) and the
encoder (std_zstd_enc.c) are C. Frames are decoded whole: the streaming
Reader emits a frame's content once all of it has arrived. Dictionaries
are not supported.

items.name: Compress
items.doc:
Compresses data into one zstd frame with a content checksum. Levels
1 (fastest) .. 19 (more match search); 0 or negative means 3. The
encoder is simpler than the reference one (predefined sequence tables,
no repeat offsets): ratios are between reference levels 1 and 3.
items.summary: Compresses data into one zstd frame with a content checksum.

items.name: Decompress
items.doc: Decompresses all frames of data (skippable frames are skipped).
items.summary: Decompresses all frames of data (skippable frames are skipped).

items.name: IsFrame
items.doc: Reports whether data starts with a zstd frame magic number.
items.summary: Reports whether data starts with a zstd frame magic number.

items.name: Reader
items.doc:
A streaming decompressor: Feed chunks; Read returns the content of the
frames completed so far.
items.summary: A streaming decompressor: Feed chunks; Read returns the content of the frames completed so far.

members.name: Read
members.doc: The decompressed bytes produced since the last call.
members.summary: The decompressed bytes produced since the last call.

members.name: Done
members.doc: True when at least one frame was decoded and no other is in progress.
members.summary: True when at least one frame was decoded and no other is in progress.
